recipe.label: WIOD 2016 · SUT · current prices
recipe.ghg_method: No local WIOD environmental accounts. Socio-economic accounts are not GHG emissions.
recipe.gdp_basis: Value added at basic prices plus net product taxes on intermediate and final uses
recipe.gdp_note: Source VA plus TXSP on intermediate and final uses, independently reconciled by country. Balancing and transport-margin rows are excluded.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
recipe.attribution: WIOD 2016 release, Timmer et al. (2015). CC BY 4.0; indicators calculated by MARIO.
recipe.scope_note: International SUT has 43 endogenous countries. ROW imports are external factor accounts; no complete ROW economy or World total is available.

provenance.reading_scope: Full local MARIO WIOD parse, calc_all=False; raw VA/TXSP country totals independently reconciled.
provenance.external_accounts: ROW imports retained in Va/VY factor accounts; 43 endogenous countries.
